items.text: I ask you out of curiosity.
He went out of the room.
As a Christian, how could you lie?
alternatives: As a Christian, how can you lie?
As a Christian, how can you tell a lie?
As a Christian, how could you tell a lie?
How could you lie as a Christian?

items.text: He is twice as rich as you are.
alternatives: He is twice as rich as you.
He is two times as rich as you are.

items.text: I respect him as a soldier.
alternatives: As a soldier, I respect him.

items.text: You should come here by ten o'clock.
alternatives: You must come here by ten o'clock.

Tomorrow the weather will be fine.

items.text: He would go to the library when he prepared for the examination.
alternatives: He would go to the library when he prepared for the exam.
He would go to the library when he was preparing for the exam.
When he prepared for the exam, he would go to the library.

He will turn 15 tomorrow.
He will be fifteen years old tomorrow.

Tomorrow he will be fifteen.

items.text: I could go to college with the money.
alternatives: I could go to university with the money.
With the money, I could go to college.

items.text: Nowadays no one could do that.
alternatives: Nowadays nobody could do that.

Nowadays nobody could do it.
